observations: Photo 0: Front view of a black Nikon DSLR camera with 'Nikon' logo on top and 'D3300' on the front right. The lens is attached, labeled 'NIKKOR AF-S DX 18-55G'. The camera body shows some dust and wear. A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI MCSTEVE' is visible.
Photo 1: Side view of the camera, showing the lens with focus and zoom rings, and the 'D3300' model name on the body. The camera strap is attached. The background shows a store shelf with boxes.
Photo 2: Top-down view of the camera, showing the lens, shutter button, and top controls. The camera appears to be in used condition with some scuffs and dust. The watermark is again present.

claims.claim: This is a Used Nikon D3300 DSLR camera with 18-55mm lens
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the Nikon D3300 model name on the camera body and the 18-55mm lens attached.
No photo shows the camera powered on or in use. No proof of functionality is provided.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not be functional (e.g., shutter failure, sensor damage, or software issues)
risks.proof: A video clip showing the camera powering on, taking a photo, and displaying the image on a screen.

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus, scratches, or internal damage not visible in photos
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens glass, especially the front and rear elements, under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with potential defects

risks.risk: Camera may have internal damage or missing parts (e.g., battery, charger, strap)
risks.proof: Photo showing the battery, charger, and strap included, and a close-up of the battery compartment and charger port.

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on and taking a photo.
Close-up photo of the lens glass under bright light.
Photo of the battery and charger included.
Photo of the battery compartment and charger port.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
